results.title_inferred: Pascaerte van de Caribes Eylanden (Chart of the Caribbean Islands) - title cartouche and map
results.original_text:
Pascaerte
Vande Caribes Eylanden,
Van 't Eylant Granadillos, tot 't Eylant Anguilla.
Beschreven door Arent Roggeveen.
results.translation:
Chart
of the Caribbean Islands,
From the Island of Grenadines to the Island of Anguilla.
Described by Arent Roggeveen.
results.confidence_reason: The cartouche text is clear in the Dutch script style, but numerous small island name labels scattered across the map are too small and faint to transcribe reliably.
results.translator_notes: The map contains many small place-name labels for individual islands (e.g., Barbados, St. Vincent, St. Lucia, Martinique, Guadeloupe/'La Deseada', Montserrat, Saba, Curaçao area names, St. Martin, Anguilla) which are marginal to the main title and too small to transcribe with confidence. Two stamped seals (one blue, one red) appear on the left and bottom margins, likely later library or ownership stamps, not part of the original text. A scale/legend box appears in the lower right corner with additional small text not fully legible.
